sources.label: Dev and staging hosts
sources.description: Non-production hosts that search engines indexed.
queries: site:{domain} inurl:dev OR inurl:staging OR inurl:test OR inurl:uat
sources.author: Shadowcrumbs pack

sources.label: API endpoints and docs
sources.description: Hosts serving APIs, Swagger or API documentation.
queries: site:{domain} inurl:api OR inurl:swagger OR inurl:api-docs
sources.author: Shadowcrumbs pack

sources.label: Open directory listings
sources.description: Pages titled 'index of', which are open folder listings.
sources.author: Shadowcrumbs pack

sources.label: Remote access front doors
sources.description: Webmail, Citrix and VPN login pages.
queries: site:{domain} intitle:"Outlook Web" OR intitle:Citrix OR intitle:GlobalProtect OR intitle:"Pulse Secure"
sources.author: Shadowcrumbs pack

sources.label: Admin tools facing the internet
sources.description: Jenkins, Grafana, Kibana and Jira pages that were not meant to be public.
queries: site:{domain} intitle:Jenkins OR intitle:Grafana OR intitle:Kibana OR intitle:Jira
sources.author: Shadowcrumbs pack

sources.label: Default server pages
sources.description: Out of the box Tomcat, IIS and nginx pages, which name the software.
queries: site:{domain} intitle:"Apache Tomcat" OR intitle:"IIS Windows Server" OR intitle:"Welcome to nginx"
sources.author: Shadowcrumbs pack

sources.label: Team and leadership pages
queries: site:{domain} "our team" OR leadership OR "meet the"
sources.author: Shadowcrumbs pack
